I can’t reliably calculate the final values by hand from this long sequence. To get the exact result, save the assignments as `assignments.R` and run:

```r
env <- new.env(parent = baseenv())
sys.source("assignments.R", envir = env)
v <- unlist(mget(c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP"), envir = env))
cat(sprintf(
  "ANSWER: a ?= %s; b ?= %s; c ?= %s; d ?= %s; e ?= %s; f ?= %s; g ?= %s; h ?= %s; TMP ?= %s;\n",
  v["a"], v["b"], v["c"], v["d"], v["e"], v["f"], v["g"], v["h"], v["TMP"]
))
```
